mechanisms: Conversation state schema 19 stores bounded, hash-bound action and attributed-proposition groups with canonical topic keys outside semantic concept payloads.
One referent may belong to multiple groups; ordinal, recency, active-topic, and explicit surface-topic selectors resolve typed candidates and ambiguity fails closed.
Historical action groups read the action-state ledger, while the active-goal set keeps current-goal semantics; read-only historical queries do not revive execution authority.
Proposition groups retain source identity and select the newest compatible source-and-topic proposition so unrelated later claims cannot absorb a scoped correction.
Korean and English topic aliases canonicalize to shared topic keys without granting lexical strings semantic authority.
Completion reports remain unverified language reports and every group-state result retains member-level evidence provenance.
residual_limits: This is bounded deterministic language engineering and does not establish GPT-level open-domain language competence.
Group memory is bounded to eight groups and sixteen turns and uses a compact inspectable Korean and English topic vocabulary.
Arbitrary nested or composite discourse sets and explicit membership revision are not yet modeled.
Unrestricted associative bridging, broad ellipsis reconstruction, and open-domain pragmatic inference remain unsolved.
Natural realization remains formulaic even though its claims are provenance-checked.

broader typed deixis and ellipsis resolution over discourse state
